principal_change: Raised MAX_SEQ_LENGTH from 1,536 to 2,048 tokens to support RAG integration. Added 24 RAG-format examples teaching [source-N] citation markers.
motivation: RAG subsystem was integrated after v2 and prompt budget grew to fit evidence + citations. A 1,536-token training sequence was too short to teach the model to attend to evidence at the end of a long prompt.
achieved: Supported RAG integration. Used in the controlled RAG study (the 93.5% unsupported-claims reduction reported in Section 5.10).
not_achieved: Exposed six defects: (i) IFEval placeholder-pollution bug (memorised hardcoded strings like 'the quick brown fox'); (ii) crisis-disclosure probes 0% pass; (iii) RAG probes 0% citation use; (iv) IFEval 28% pass; (v) over-refusal 7/20; (vi) system-prompt echo.
report_reference: Section 4.10 (lineage), Section 5.10 Table 14 (paired v3 subsystem study), Section 5.10 Table 15 (v3 Sentinel failures)
release_status: historical (used as identity for the v3 RAG study)
